title: Cost
description: A provider-sourced sandbox cost. Unknown has a null total; known totals are exact decimal strings. Hourly rate-card quotes may be ranges.

label.description: reported: a provider amount verified at list price; calculated: provider usage priced at stored list rates; unknown: required provider evidence or a rate is missing.

total.description: An exact USD amount, low equal to high, or null for unknown.

lines.description: The working: one line per charged resource. Empty when the provider's own figure is all we have, or when nothing could be worked out.

unit.description: The price version's unit for this rate, for example vcpu-second.

rate.description: US dollars per unit, as the price version states it.

quantity_source.description: The source of the usage facts the quantity came from; the least certain one when it came from several.

held_back_by.description: The reasons the label is not better, with a stable code and resource. Empty for `reported` and `calculated`.

exclusions.description: What the figure leaves out, such as plan fees, credits and discounts.

price_version.description: The id of the price version used, which carries the quotes (for example e2b@2026-10-20-061802Z, or modal@2026-10-20-061900Z when more than one version was read that day). Null when none was in effect.

as_of.description: When the cost was worked out, so the cost of a sandbox that is still running reads as the cost so far.

per_hour.description: US dollars per hour while the sandbox keeps running, for a running sandbox only.

reported_figure.description: Where a `reported` total came from. Present exactly when the label is `reported`.

how.description: The API call that returned the figure.

source.description: Where a fact came from. The same six values as the usage record's source; a test keeps the two lists equal.

timestamp.description: A UTC time, ending in Z.

decimal.description: A non-negative decimal number as a string, in plain notation without an exponent.

total_range.description: Exact USD total: low equals high.

money_range.description: US dollars as a range; low equals high when the amount is exact.
